context: Request: the underwriting breakdown of every Capital Markets matter (including shelved, withdrawn and never-executed ones) across firm-commitment, best-efforts and other structures. Rubric: 20 matters as firm commitment, including IPO and follow-on underwriting agreements and Rule 144A initial-purchaser note offerings (e.g. 1005-00002, 1014-00001, 1016-00003, 1021-00002, 1039-00002, 1044-00004, 1045-00001), the block trade 1017-00001 and 1020-00003; the ATM program 1036-00002 as best efforts; the direct Reg D placement 1013-00002 as other; plus precision (placement-agent, fund PPM, bond and ABS matters such as 1004-00002, 1024-00004, 1030-00001, 1045-00006 are outside).

divergence: All three runs failed the same way. Each surfaced nearly every needed matter through store-wide scans and file-name candidate lists, then read a hand-picked subset: the first error in all three is surfaced-not-opened at the first screening reads (five matters in T0, four in T1, one in T2), with the block-trade matter never opened in any run. All three also placed the agency program outside best efforts and counted extra bond, securitization or placement matters; T0 also put several note offerings in the wrong bucket. Reviews flagged hand-picked reads in every run (by series name in T1), but no run opened the missed matters; T2 declared six new stages around background scan polling and candidate review, all matching existing stages.
